policies.title: Grenada: Iranian ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's live Embassy nationality schedule directly places Iran in the prior-arrival visa category.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Iranian passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule defines Prior To Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The schedule was revised in April 2024; recheck early if Grenada publishes a later schedule.
Does not classify work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service or special-document travel.

policies.title: Panama: Iranian ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule expressly includes Iran in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring consular filing before travel for visitors without the separate third-country-document waiver.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Iranian passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The published authorized-visa procedure requires the applicant to appear in person at the consulate and says approval can take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, invitation and final-admission treatment are not classified by this policy.
